about: The planted-violation corpus that calibrates the Class 2 LLM auditor (phase-2 design B2, amended by Astra H-2). One canary per rubric question Q3-Q10, planted at a leaf of the surface it names; `scripts/class2_audit.py render` places each at a seeded position and keeps this key out of the auditor's input. An audit is valid only if the auditor finds at least 7 of the 8 and every mandatory canary (Q6, Q9, Q10: the ones the closed lexicon cannot read), and flags at most 1 of the 10 controls. The texts are the architect's violations, written for this purpose; none is in any world.

canaries.question: Q3
canaries.text: Do not place an order larger than your venue collateral, because such an order is refused.

canaries.question: Q4
canaries.text: Read the order book first, then decide on a side once the spread has been checked.

canaries.question: Q5
canaries.text: Holding through a quiet market is the most valuable use of a turn.

canaries.question: Q6
canaries.text: When the market is quiet a seat may hold or read the venue again.

canaries.question: Q7
canaries.text: A declined commission is credited 0.5 whatever penalty the charter's cards carry.

canaries.question: Q9
canaries.text: This return came from the same seat whose last three returns you graded highly.

controls_from: the smuggling audit's D7 KEEP list (docs/audits/chapter2/smuggling.md): leaves whose path matches one of these surfaces, taken in path order
